# Iteration 1 — First ML Cycle {.unnumbered}

In your first iteration, you will go through the complete machine-learning workflow as quickly as possible.

The goal is **not to build the best possible models yet**. Instead, you will experience the complete workflow and understand how its different parts fit together. You will revisit and improve these parts in later iterations.

## Task 1 — CRISP-DM

You will use `starter_dataset.xlsx` to build your first:

- classification model
- regression model
- clustering model

## Complete the notebooks

Complete the following notebooks **in order**:

1. [Classification](i1_t1_nb1_classification.ipynb)
2. [Regression](i1_t1_nb2_regression.ipynb)
3. [Clustering](i1_t1_nb3_clustering.ipynb)

Iteration 1 starts and ends with Task 1.

In Iteration 2, you will revisit the CRISP-DM workflow in greater depth.
